newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens says has 100 pct of Hille.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens says has 100 pct of Hille.

text.p: Steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Thursday it had bought the remaining 50 percent of shares in German steel firm Hille & Muller, becoming the sole owner.
Hoogovens had held a 50 percent stake in the German firm since 1988. Hille & Muller consists of a group of companies in Germany, Britain and the U.S.
The firm specialises in cold rolling, plating and coating of hot-rolled steel. It has a workforce of 1,450 people and posts annual turnover of more than 500 million guilders.

Hoogovens said the deal, of which no financial details were given, provided it with full control over the production chain from manufacturing hot-rolled steel to cold-rolling and finishing. It said this would strengthen its position in the market for high-quality end products.

Hoogovens said Hille & Muller would step up its cooperation with German metals group Heitkamp & Thumann of which it is the main supplier of raw materials. This strategic alliance will be expanded, it said.

A Hoogovens move, which was announced last June and was scheduled to take place at the beginning of this year, to directly participate in Heitkamp & Thumann will not go ahead for the moment, the Dutch firm said.
